hooks.command: bash -c 'set +e; _dir="${PWD:-}"; _prev=""; _iters=0; while [ "$_dir" != "$_prev" ] && [ "$_iters" -lt 40 ]; do _h="$_dir/.claude/hooks/verbosity-remind.sh"; [ -f "$_h" ] && [ -r "$_h" ] && { bash "$_h"; exit $?; }; _prev="$_dir"; _dir="${_dir%/*}"; [ -z "$_dir" ] && _dir=/; _iters=$(($_iters+1)); done; exit 0'

bash -c 'set +e; _dir="${PWD:-}"; _prev=""; _i=0; while [ "$_dir" != "$_prev" ] && [ "$_i" -lt 40 ]; do _h="$_dir/.claude/hooks/context-guard.sh"; [ -f "$_h" ] && [ -r "$_h" ] && { CC_PROJECT_ROOT="$_dir" bash "$_h"; exit $?; }; _prev="$_dir"; _dir="${_dir%/*}"; [ -z "$_dir" ] && _dir=/; _i=$((_i+1)); done; exit 0'
